prompt: A 300 ml bottle of shampoo costs $6. A 600 ml bottle of the same shampoo costs $9. Which bottle is better value?

options.text: They are exactly the same value
It is impossible to compare them

explanation: The small bottle costs $6 / 3 = $2 per 100 ml. The large bottle costs $9 / 6 = $1.50 per 100 ml, so the 600 ml bottle is better value.
